title: Zoomable Mandelbrot
why: Pure numerical code plus an interaction model. Wrong escape-time maths produces something that still renders but is visibly not a Mandelbrot set, so it fails loudly rather than silently.
prompt: Write a single self-contained HTML file that renders the Mandelbrot set on a canvas and lets the user click to zoom in and shift-click to zoom out. Colour the escape-time bands smoothly. Use only HTML, CSS and vanilla JavaScript. Output only the file contents.
